title: Seasonal analysis of organic aerosol composition resolves anthropogenic and biogenic sources at a rural background station in central Europe
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,703-713
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00163J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Markus Thoma, Franziska Bachmeier, Karina Knauf, Julia David, Mario Simon, Alexander L. Vogel
Organic aerosols (OA) affect climate and health, yet their molecular composition is still largely unclear. A top–down approach employing offline measurements and non-target analysis clarifies OA composition and enables source attribution.
